content: Live-verified (curl) https://standards-oui.ieee.org/oui/oui.csv returns 200 OK, Content-Type application/octet-stream, ~3.8MB raw CSV, Last-Modified header shows same-day updates (daily refresh cadence), CSV columns: Registry,Assignment,Organization Name,Organization Address. Three registry tiers exist: MA-L (standards-oui.ieee.org/oui/oui.csv, 24-bit prefix, the classic 'OUI'), MA-M (oui28/mam.csv, 28-bit), MA-S/OUI-36 (oui36/oui36.csv, 36-bit). For a MAC vendor lookup tool, MA-L alone covers the vast majority of real-world devices; MA-M/MA-S add coverage for orgs that bought smaller blocks. Files are public, no auth, no rate limit encountered on a single fetch.
